module "ShaderBesideFunction.dsm"

  legacy root ""

  outputs %3

product 1 Material "M_LiBeside" backend=Graph
  legacy root ""
  %0 = Constant(Value=(1, 0.5, 0.25)) : float3 @L26:C29 "Color"

  %2 = MaterialSink(EmissiveColor=%1) @L18:C1
  sink %2
